name: Endless Halls
hook: Find the keys. Stay together. Don't listen too long.
how: Wander endless yellow halls with your friends to find three keys, then the EXIT to the next level. Something walks the halls with you: you hear it before you see it, and it comes for whoever is alone.
controls: WASD to walk, drag the mouse to look, Shift to run, or the touch stick, drag to look and RUN
uses: The host's browser builds each level from a seed, moves the entity and decides who gets taken; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot explorers search the halls, find keys and run with you until friends join.
Everyone walks the same halls and sees each other move.
The deepest level each player reached.
ideas: Add a flashlight with a battery that runs out
Make every fifth level a flooded pool room
Add a second entity that only moves when nobody looks at it
